title: GET /api/v1/meta/object loads the whole registry (97 objects, 745 KB) on every console open; the cloud control plane's pricing page reads no object
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2914 (the control plane's console open: 13 s to the last API response on staging, 30 calls with duplicates) cannot meet its acceptance (a splash under 4 s, a call budget) from cloud. The os-dev on that card measured one full console open on a local control plane at framework `f7e836da1ed3` / objectui `ef71a09f9e5f`, with Chromium and CDP initiator stacks mapped through source maps, on SQLite and on Postgres behind a 50 ms round trip (report `6225536289` on cloud#2914; every call's table is in the Attribution section of PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2941). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: the 74 most recent open objectui issues carry no card on scoping `/meta/object` per app.

## Measured (objectui `ef71a09f9e5f`)

- **Every console open** issues `GET /api/v1/meta/object`. It returns all 97 registered objects, 745 KB, in 473 ms at 50 ms RTT (the card read 5.7 s and 106 KB on staging).
- **The first reader** is the `objects` getter of `packages/app-shell/src/providers/MetadataProvider.tsx:752` (`:1113`). It is touched by `hooks/useActionModal.tsx:159` from `console/ConsoleShell.tsx:94`, and by `AppContent.tsx:229`.
- **The control plane needs few of them.** Its app has four objects of its own, and the pricing page reads no object at all.
- **The framework already scopes this read:** `getMetaItems` takes a `packageId` (objectstack `f7e836da1ed3` `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:9606`).

## Done when

- **The console requests the current app's objects only.** For example, by the app's package, or by the object names its navigation and pages bind.
- **It fetches another object's metadata on demand,** when a record, lookup or action needs it.
- **The whole-registry call is not on the open path.**
- **A test** pins the request one console open issues.

Dedupe words: meta/object whole registry, scoped object metadata, MetadataProvider objects getter, packageId getMetaItems.
